agent.summary_withheld: K201620 (Luna G3 BPAP 25A, 3B Medical) cites two direct predicates: K131982 (REMSTAR AUTO A-FLEX HT, Philips Respironics) and K133769 (RESMART BPAP 25A, 3B Medical/BMC). The K131982 link was flagged by an earlier audit as a possible typo because the FDA summary names the device "DreamStation Auto BiPAP" while openFDA lists it as "REMSTAR AUTO A-FLEX HT". Verification against the cached FDA summary (SHA-256 6526ad2f7f0eff1fef40d93c04b7559a477a3a0e0306d38c77b7def4f71202cf, page 6) confirms the printed K-number is K131982 and the text reads "DreamStation Auto BiPAP (K131982)". The link is therefore valid; the name difference reflects a submission-era vs. marketing name. K131982 carries five Class I recall records across three events (Z-1974-2021, Z-1322-2023, Z-2227/8/9-2025). The 2021 event (88058) is design-related (PE-PUR foam degradation) and also links grand-predicate K113068 and great-grand-predicate K091319. A 2024 design-related recall (Z-1817-2024) also links K113068. The second direct predicate K133769 and its ancestry show no recalls. One generation-4 ancestor (K021861) has an unread summary (ok_no_predicate_found), leaving a minor gap. Verdict: REVIEW_LINEAGE due to design
